title: I made an ARPG inspired by Path of Exile and WoW that runs in your browser
author: tooavg
selftext:
IIt’s called Moonwell. I took ideas from my two favourite games: talent trees with game-changing keystones from PoE, and boss fights and class feel from WoW. Three classes, cursed dungeons, loot.

Claude wrote most of the code and I did the design. What I learned: AI can build pretty much anything, but it can’t tell when something is boring, and neither can I lol. I tried to make it pretty stimulating, but my friends wouldn’t bother to finish more than the first dungeon.

Honest feedback is appreciated. Here’s the link if you want to try it out;

[https://vestom.itch.io/moonwell](https://vestom.itch.io/moonwell)

comments.body: Usually, I'm against AI made projects, but yours plays really good. The thing that concerns me is balance, build variety and such, but does not look like a bad foundation.
